summary: Enhance your understanding of business law and ethics in finance with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with essential skills for success.
lede: Business law and ethics in finance helps finance, treasury, risk, audit, and compliance professionals assess legal and conduct risks in decisions and transactions. The course covers reviewing contract terms, analyzing conflicts and ethical cases, mapping compliance controls, and documenting and escalating issues through clear records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle finance decisions, control checks, conduct issues, and compliance reporting.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working familiarity with finance operations, contracts, or compliance processes. No legal qualification is required, but you should be comfortable reading policy documents, transaction summaries, and approval records. Prior exposure to finance controls, ethics policies, or audit follow-up will help you get more value from the case work. No programming or coding is required. Advanced legal analysis is covered at an operational level, with practical application to finance decisions, reviews, and reporting.
